dict.Convocare la cercetarea disciplinară pre: Notice to attend the preliminary disciplinary inquiry
dict.Convocarea scrisă a angajatului la cerce: The employee's written notice to attend the disciplinary inquiry: the act they are accused of, the date, time and place of the meeting, the committee or person conducting the inquiry, their rights (defence, evidence, assistance) and what happens if they do not attend; with proof of receipt
